config.title: DeepSeek Harness
config.url: DSH web server URL (usually the local loopback address).
config.autoStart: On VS Code startup, automatically start `dsh web` if the server is not running (falls back to `npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest` when `dsh` is not found).
config.command: Command used to start the server; falls back to `npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest` when not found.
config.autoStartTimeoutSec: Maximum seconds to wait when auto-starting the server.
config.participantSessionMode: Session scope for the @dsh chat participant.
config.participantSessionMode.perWorkspa: One @dsh session per project (workspace folder); multi-root workspaces follow the active editor (recommended)
config.participantSessionMode.global: All projects share a single @dsh session
config.openPanelOnStartup: Automatically open the standalone DSH chat window on VS Code startup (off by default; the primary entry is the @dsh participant in the built-in Chat).
config.defaultReasoningEffort: Thinking depth (reasoning effort, e.g. off / low / high / max depending on the model) applied to newly created sessions. Leave empty to use the model default; the chat window toolbar can adjust the current session at any time.
config.commitModel: Model used to generate git commit messages from the Source Control view. Resolved from the DSH model catalog (e.g. deepseek-v4-flash); falls back to the session's current model when not found.
config.commitReasoningEffort: Reasoning effort for commit message generation. "low" means no/minimal thinking on DeepSeek models (fastest).
config.language: UI language of the extension (chat panel, notifications, @dsh replies).
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language (default)
config.agentDirs: Model config compatibility: enable compatibility with each tool's config directories (workspace folder and user home)
config.agentDirs.claude: Compatible with Claude — scan .claude (commands, skills) in the workspace and your user home (~/.claude), and report CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md
config.agentDirs.codex: Compatible with Codex — scan .codex (config.toml, skills) in the workspace and your user home (~/.codex)
config.agentDirs.githubCopilot: Compatible with GitHub Copilot — scan .github (instructions, agents, prompts) in the workspace and your user home (~/.github)
config.installRollbackPlugin: Automatically install the turn-level Git rollback plugin into the DSH web profile (enables /rollback, /redo, /checkpoints; takes effect after the DSH server restarts)
config.agentDirs.dshUserSkills: Show / hide DSH user-global skills (~/.dsh/skills, ~/.agents/skills) in the available-skills list
